notes: RNS 1.4.2 loaded through the benchmark-local Cython object cache. The load is gated on RNS.compiled being true and at least one native extension module being present. That gate does not establish which modules were compiled: measured on 2026-09-18 at Cython 3.2.8, this build produces 1 native extension module, the top-level RNS package, and leaves 43 interpreted, including Transport, Link, Packet, Identity, Destination, Resource and Reticulum. The proof record emitted by compiled_reference.py now lists all of them, so a run can be checked rather than assumed.
